headline: Equation 2.4 · Recursive α Partition

items.title: Axis Selector α
items.detail: Gender, wealth, credentials, religion, citizenship, geography, criminal record.

items.title: X⁺_α and X⁻_α
items.detail: Vertical cut divides any subset X into locally advantaged and subordinated cells.

items.title: α = gender in I_buffer
items.detail: Male head-of-household authority versus female coverture subordination (Chapter 8).

items.title: α = property / felony
items.detail: Second cut yields four compartments with distinct legal rights and wage ceilings.

items.title: α = credentials in O_racialized
items.detail: Selective incorporation O⁺_α above mass containment O⁻_α.

items.title: Partition notation
items.detail: Each split writes X = X⁺_α ∪̇ X⁻_α with disjoint cells.

sources: The Original Power, Ch. 2, §2.1, Eq. 2.4; Ch. 8
